name: Bete Grise
summary: You play as Pom. A cheery night manager of the Bete Grise hotel. A quiet, lonely shift in a hotel with strange happenings, and peculiar guests. The scene begins at midnight. Make the rounds, checking any left over work by housekeeping. Fold towels, make beds, repair vending machines, check the front desk for requests or notes. There is a mystery here. Will you be ready to welcome tonight’s special guests? An isometric adventure game with 90's style graphics.
